caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate pitcher rendered in pencil on a light beige or off-white paper. The pitcher has a wide, rounded body with a pronounced lip for pouring and a flared top edge. The handle is elaborate, featuring a large, looping curve extending upward and then curling inward at the top. The base of the pitcher is broad and tiered, supporting the bulbous central portion which tapers in and then flares outward near the upper section. The drawing uses shading to convey the metallic texture and rounded form of the pitcher, suggesting reflections and highlights on the surface. There is handwritten text in the upper left corner that reads "SILVER PITCHER" followed by cataloging information, as well as a stamp near the bottom reading "F.A.W. WING MET. MUSEUM" and another set of handwriting nearby. The overall composition is centered, with the pitcher occupying most of the space on the page and no additional objects or background elements visible.
title: Silver Pitcher
